findings: extensions/navigate-tree/index.ts buildContextMessages projects the session tree; tests cover honoring context_edit omissions and clearing stale assistant usage after edits while preserving post-edit usage.

extensions/navigate-tree/retrospective-plan.ts readSessionSnapshot hashes raw bytes and validates graph ancestry, safe cuts, and pending tool calls before planning; token estimates remain heuristic rather than provider-tokenization proof.

extensions/navigate-tree/index.ts buildContextMessages uses projection entries, invalidates stale usage, truncates pending rewind context to its instruction, adjusts failed tool results, then removes system messages; projection and in-band rewind details affect visibility accounting.

extensions/navigate-tree/handoff.ts handoffStats deduplicates usage by entry ID and aggregates message/usage/compaction/branch_summary records. Slash-containing wildcard model patterns may match modelId as well as the full key, a potential matching ambiguity.

extensions/navigate-tree/auto-navigate.ts evaluateAutoNavigateTurn bounds serialized UTF-8 payload and validates returned IDs and anchors; its payload identifies older records withheld from the controller.

extensions/navigate-tree/context-tokens.ts estimateContextTokens combines host estimateTokens with recorded-usage baseline and heuristic tail; estimateRequestTokens applies an 8/7 factor. Tests disclaim cross-version numeric parity; circular toolCall arguments can throw TypeError, a potential robustness issue if such input reaches the estimator.

extensions/navigate-tree/continuity-briefing.ts drops facts, files, and steering in order but flags overBudget when nondroppable content exceeds the limit. continuity-store.ts restores fold snapshots at branch summaries and skips malformed ops with warnings.

extensions/navigate-tree/handoff-projection.ts invalidateStaleUsage clears stale usage on projected copies, and projectHandoffs strips usage from historical clone entries without changing persisted accounting.

extensions/navigate-tree/index.ts planWithhold selects eligible results from canonical projection, excludes navigator and already-edited results, reprojects proposed edits, and calibrates estimates from real usage while enforcing a complete-request bound.
extensions/navigate-tree/config.ts mergeHintField allows a present invalid project hint to override the global hint; fallback fields may instead use a valid lower-layer value.
